lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean after a Lanczos upscale reproduction to the 2560 px final canvas; gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: Neutral form shading and local ambient occlusion are present; no cast-shadow field, sun angle, sky gradient, or time-of-day lighting was observed.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median bounding-box width across 18 isolated dark-green conifer crown components, scaled by 2560/1254.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Full-source authoring estimate: the broad level border knoll and coherent long moor slopes count as buildable; the beck gully and basalt face count as steep; boulder, talus, scrub, and broken moor make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels
water_mask.method: Source-pixel chroma and luminance segmentation constrained to the visually inspected full painted channel; channel-center continuity, pixel-derived bank stops, fringe admission, local smoothing, and enclosed-hole filling cover riffles, reflections, wet margins, and water between rocks. The terrain source remained byte-identical.

source_scale_gate_proxy.note: The pipeline classifier was reproduced at proportionally scaled source radii because node.exe is not exposed in this managed shell.

open_risks: The inherited east-side basalt break continues as a long, fairly regular column wall. It is curved and has some broken drums and talus, but it still risks reading as a palisade against the owner weathering rule; the one permitted edit call cannot now correct the raw source.
The official Node authoring gates were not run because node.exe is not exposed in this managed shell; the 6 px and 48 px fringe results are source-scale reproductions.
Visual seam, composition, and terrain-quality judgment remain owner decisions; mechanical checks do not establish visual acceptance.
